question: Does averaging hex6_all over two independent detectors (stride-8 specialist, stride-2 seed 46) or gating the blend weight by the number of bounded cells push the HEX gain towards the gate?
variants: A: feature = geometric mean of the two hex6_all (no fitting), LOFO blend
B: stride-2 hex6_all with row weight w*min(1, n_bounded/100), w on fitting folds
pre_specified_decision: gate -0.09 pp HEX (-0.03 mean), >= 2 folds; A is the primary (parameter-free combination); B is secondary
falsification: A no better than the better single detector means the two detectors' errors are the same errors (correlation of log hex6 reported)
